title: Settle pending request
goal: Settle a pending host-agent request and advance the cursor on success.

sessionId.description: Session ID containing the pending request.

attemptId.description: The pending request's own attempt id; a settlement binds one exact attempt.

requestHash.description: The pending request's idempotency key, binding the settlement to one exact request.

result.description: Settlement result as a JSON object with a closed status (succeeded, skipped, failed, cancelled, unknown, timed_out, rejected).

ownerId.description: Lease owner (agentId); only the owner that created the request may settle it.

tokenHash.description: SHA-256 digest of the current lease token.

leaseFence.description: Current lease fence; a request carrying an older fence can never settle.

submissionCriteria: attemptId, requestHash, ownerId, tokenHash, and leaseFence match the pending request and current lease
result is a valid closed-contract settlement JSON
